pages.text: The morning sky was blue. Taro and Mumu met in the middle of the road. It was a good day for playing in the water.
"Let's meet at the stream after breakfast and dip our feet in!" Mumu bounded up. "Okay! See you later."
But rain was strange in this village. It poured on one side of the road while the sun shone on the other.
Rain drummed on Taro's roof. Rat-a-tat-tat. "With rain like this, Mumu won't be able to come out either."
Taro sat on the wooden porch. He rested his chin on his knees and watched the rain. Water pooled in the yard.
The soil by the stream was dry. Mumu was already there, waiting for Taro with feet in the water.
"Why isn't Taro coming?" Mumu kicked and splashed. Only Mumu's feet were in the stream.
The rain grew lighter. Taro went into the yard. Only the sky on the other side was blue!
Taro ran along the road. Right in the middle, the rain stopped. Wisps of steam rose from the ground.
Only one of Taro's shoulders was wet. Mumu poked it, getting water on a finger. "It only rained here!"
